text:
emma_support: FYI customer ACME (ticket #12345) says Analytics dashboard shows no data when they set Region=EU + Model=Llama-2-70b v1. API usage and billing still show traffic. Can someone triage? :thinking_face:

jordan_prod: I can reproduce in staging. If I select region=eu and then pick model+version the charts go blank. If I remove the version the charts come back.

li_eng: possible filter normalization bug. Console query builder collapses model+version into model_alias, but we may be generating an empty `version` term when the alias mapping fails.

alex_research: grabbed logs from metrics-service: `WARN filter_parser: failed parse for filter key=\"model\", value=\"llama-2-70b@v1\" -> normalized to {model: \"llama-2-70b\", version: \"\"}`

emma_support: repro steps from customer: 1) Console -> Analytics 2) Select Region = EU 3) Model dropdown -> Llama-2-70b -> choose version v1 4) All charts show "No data" 5) Call to /v1/usage for same org/timeframe returns token counts. Screenshot: https://redwood-internal.s3/aa/attachments/acme-empty-charts.png

li_eng: can you paste the ES query the UI is sending?

jordan_prod: here's the query we see in staging (redacted):
```json
{
  "bool": {
    "must": [
      {"term": {"region": "eu"}},
      {"term": {"model": "llama-2-70b"}},
      {"term": {"version": ""}}
    ]
  }
}
```
That empty `version` term makes ES return zero results.

alex_research: this looks like a regression from alias-normalizer PR (#789). It now emits version = empty string when it cannot map alias->version for combined selection. Previously UI would omit the version clause entirely.

sre_oncall: timeline? when did that PR go live?

alex_research: merged 2026-01-05, rolled to prod 2026-01-09. First customer reports on 2026-01-10 09:12 UTC.

emma_support: impact: 3 enterprise customers reported so far. They can't see cost/latency breakdowns by version which blocks audits. High priority.

li_eng: quick mitigation: change query builder to drop filters where value == "". I'll open a hotfix branch + PR with unit test. Longer term we should fix alias-normalizer to never emit empty strings.

jordan_prod: also adding a defensive UI check: when building filter array, filter out falsy values. That should be safe and fast.

li_eng: PR created: https://git.redwood/metrics/compare/pr/802 — small change in metrics-query-builder. Tests added.

emma_support: can you include the ticket link and the exact repro in the PR description so I can update the customers?

deploy-bot: Deploy pipeline started for branch pr/802 -> metrics-query-builder/hotfix. CI passed (unit tests). Staging deploy successful. Prod deploy queued.

jordan_prod: deployed to prod at 2026-01-10 09:48 UTC. I verified ACME's console — charts returned immediately after clearing the empty version term.

li_eng: follow-up: creating issue to revert the alias-normalizer behavior until we implement a clear mapping table. Filed as RW-ISSUE-1246.

emma_support: great. I'll message ACME with the fix and close the ticket once they confirm. Thanks everyone :tada:

alex_research: added a note to the release changelog about the regression and the hotfix.

sre_oncall: recommend we add an e2e test that selects region+model+version to prevent regressions.

li_eng: ack — adding e2e test to RW-ISSUE-1246, will follow up in that ticket.

emma_support: closing the loop — ACME confirmed metrics are back and they can see versioned breakdowns. I'll update the internal incident doc and mark P1 -> resolved. :white_check_mark:
